How to check you are buying the original

  • Check the seal. Look at the authentication seal on the lid when your parcel arrives.
  • Read the pack. The packaging should list Kojic Acid and Alpha Arbutin and show directions for use.
  • Be careful with very low prices. A jar sold far below ₹549 by an unknown seller may not be genuine.
  • Know who you are buying from. A real seller gives a name, address and phone number. Ours is Beauty Mart, Bhatkal, Karnataka.

What to check before buying any beauty cream online

Whichever cream you choose, these checks help you buy safely online in India:

  • Ingredient list: the key ingredients should be named on the pack and the product page. For dark spots and uneven tone, people commonly look for kojic acid, alpha arbutin, niacinamide or vitamin C.
  • Honest claims: be wary of creams that promise to change your skin colour or show results overnight.
  • Seller details: a business name, address and customer care number you can actually reach.
  • Payment options: Cash on Delivery lets you pay only when the parcel reaches you.
  • Return policy: know what happens if the parcel is damaged or wrong. Youth Face accepts requests for damaged, defective or incorrect items within 7 days of delivery. See the refund and returns policy.
